answer: The karst register is checked at draw time, wander lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 72 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 72 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 60 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
